title: bromus arvensis var. splendens
intro: Bromus arvensis var. splendens, commonly known as Brome Grass or Bromegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus arvensis var. splendens include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
